turnos.t: Can a business make a profit without throwing things away?

That's the idea of circular business models: keep products and materials in use, instead of take, make and throw away. The toolkit names five: circular supply, resource recovery, product life extension, sharing, and product service systems.

Philips lights Schiphol airport but keeps ownership of the fittings, so it earns more by making lamps last. Benefits: lower input costs and recurring revenue. Limits: high set-up costs, and customers who prefer to own.
